errors.generic: The request could not be completed. Try again.
errors.forbidden: You don't have permission for this action.
errors.VALIDATION: Some fields are invalid. Check them and submit again.
errors.CONFLICT: A record with the same details already exists.
errors.INVALID_ORG_HIERARCHY: The selected placement doesn't match the organization structure.
errors.SCOPE_NOT_ALLOWED: That scope isn't available for this permission.
errors.PAST_END_DATE: The end date cannot be in the past.
errors.TOO_MANY_REQUESTS: Too many requests in a short time. Wait a minute and try again.
errors.DERIVED_ROLE: This role follows a job title or a level of the structure, so its name and members are not changed by hand.
errors.ROLE_TEMPLATE_INVALID: That template role cannot be used: choose a manual role or the Employee role.
errors.FILE_TYPE_NOT_ALLOWED: File type not allowed. Use PDF, PNG or JPEG.
errors.AUTHENTICATOR_LOCKED: Too many attempts. Try again in a moment.
errors.ALREADY_ENROLLED: An authenticator app is already linked.
errors.MFA_REQUIRED: Enter the code from your authenticator app to continue.
errors.FIELD_RULE: A value in the form does not meet the required rule.
errors.EMPLOYEE_EMAIL_TAKEN: This work email belongs to another employee.
errors.EMPLOYEE_NUMBER_TAKEN: This employee number belongs to another employee.
errors.ID_DOCUMENT_TAKEN: This ID number is registered for another employee.
errors.INVALID_REFERENCE: One of the selected options does not exist.
errors.SELF_ACTION: You cannot do this to your own account.
errors.INVALID_PLACEMENT: The unit and job title do not fit the selected company.
errors.COMPANY_CODE_TAKEN: This company code belongs to another company.
errors.COMPANY_IN_USE: Move the company's employees and units first, then delete it.
errors.ORG_NODE_IN_USE: Move its sub-units and employees first, then delete.
errors.ORG_NODE_HAS_TICKETS: A department whose ticket desk receives tickets, or that has open tickets, cannot be moved or deleted.
errors.PAGE_HIDDEN: This page is not available to your role.
errors.LIST_SETTING_INVALID: This column or filter is not part of the list, and the first column cannot be hidden.
errors.ROLE_PAGES_LOCKED: Pages cannot be hidden from a role that manages page visibility.
errors.LAST_JOB_TITLE: A unit that accepts employees needs at least one job title.
errors.JOB_TITLE_IN_USE: Move the employees with this job title first.
errors.ORG_IMPACT_CHANGED: The affected data changed. Review the new impact and confirm again.
errors.EMPLOYEES_DECISION_REQUIRED: Choose what happens to the affected employees: transfer or delete them.
errors.INVALID_EMPLOYEES_DECISION: The employees decision is not valid. Check the target unit and job titles, or the employee count.
errors.ORG_LEVELS_NOT_EMPTY: The company has units. Change its levels from the levels form.
errors.MANAGER_NOT_FOUND: The direct manager's employee number was not found.
errors.DESK_STOPPED: This department does not receive tickets.
errors.DESK_PAUSED: The department has paused receiving tickets for now.
errors.DESK_NOT_STARTED: This department has not started working yet.
errors.DESK_NO_MANAGER: This department has no manager at the moment, so it cannot receive tickets.
errors.PERSONAL_NOT_ACCEPTED: This department does not accept personal requests.
errors.TYPE_NO_HANDLER: A personal type needs an active employee in charge of it.
errors.ASSIGNEE_INVALID: The assignee must be an active employee.
errors.DUE_DATE_TOO_EARLY: The needed-by date is earlier than the department accepts.
errors.TICKET_STATE_INVALID: This action cannot be done on the ticket in its current state.
errors.REOPEN_WINDOW_EXPIRED: The time allowed for reopening this ticket has passed.
errors.TICKET_REVISION_CONFLICT: The ticket was changed by someone else. Reload the page and try again.
errors.NOT_DESK_MANAGER: Only the department manager can do this.
errors.ADMIN_MODE_REQUIRED: Turn on platform admin mode to continue.
errors.ADMIN_MODE_NOT_ALLOWED: Platform admin mode is not available for your account.
errors.IMPERSONATION_DISABLED: Signing in as another employee is switched off in the security settings.
errors.IMPERSONATION_TARGET_INVALID: You cannot sign in as this account.
errors.IMPERSONATION_NESTED: Go back to your own account before signing in as someone else.
errors.IMPERSONATION_FORBIDDEN: This is not allowed while you are signed in as another employee.
errors.IMPERSONATION_ENDED: This session ended. You are back in your own account.
errors.CODE_ALREADY_USED: This code was already used. Wait for the next code in your app.
errors.TASK_REVISION_CONFLICT: The task was changed by someone else. Reload the page and try again.
errors.TASK_TRANSITION_NOT_ALLOWED: The task cannot be moved to this status.
errors.TASK_ASSIGNMENT_NOT_ALLOWED: You cannot give a task to this person.
errors.TASK_ASSIGNEE_INVALID: The assignee must be an active employee of the same company.
errors.TASK_NOTE_REQUIRED: Write a note when sending a task back from review.
errors.TASK_COMPLETION_DATE_REQUIRED: The task is later than the allowed time; state the real completion date.
errors.TASK_BACKDATE_TOO_FAR: A date further back than allowed, or in the future, cannot be recorded.
errors.TASK_STATE_INVALID: This action cannot be done on the task in its current state.
errors.TASK_OBJECTION_NOT_ALLOWED: You cannot object to this task now.
errors.TASK_DUE_DATE_INVALID: The due date cannot be in the past.
errors.TASK_TAG_INVALID: This tag is not available for this task.
errors.TASK_DEPARTMENT_INVALID: A tag belongs to a department of the organization structure and does not move to another.
errors.TASK_NOT_APPROVABLE: This task is not waiting for your approval.
errors.TASK_TAG_IN_USE: Tasks use this tag; turn it off instead of deleting it.
errors.TASK_POLICY_COMPANY_REQUIRED: Choose the company whose task policy you mean.
errors.PROVIDER_INCOMPLETE: The service data is incomplete. Fill in every required field.
errors.PROVIDER_NOT_TESTED: Try the service with its current data first; it can be switched on only after a passed test.
errors.PROVIDER_TEST_INPUT: Fill in the test box first.
errors.PROVIDER_TEST_RATE_LIMITED: Too many tests. Try again in a minute.
errors.TEMPLATE_UNKNOWN_VARIABLE: The text uses values this message cannot fill. Use only the values listed under the text.
errors.TEMPLATE_MISSING_VARIABLE: This message must keep a required value (the activation link). Add it back or give the button a label.
errors.TEMPLATE_INVALID_CONTENT: The text is not valid. Notifications are plain text, without tags.
errors.TEMPLATE_SELF_APPROVAL: A change must be approved by someone other than who made it.
errors.TEMPLATE_NOTHING_PENDING: No change is waiting for approval.
errors.TEMPLATE_TEST_RATE_LIMITED: Too many test messages. Try again in a minute.
errors.TASK_COMMENT_NOT_ALLOWED: You may not do this in the task conversation.
errors.TASK_COMMENT_EMPTY: Write some text or attach a file.
errors.TASK_COMMENT_TOO_MANY_FILES: There are more files than a comment may carry.
errors.TASK_COMMENT_MENTION_INVALID: You can mention active employees of the task's company only.
errors.TASK_COMMENT_EDIT_EXPIRED: The time to edit or delete the comment has passed.
errors.TASK_COMMENT_CLOSED: The conversation of this task is closed.
errors.TASK_COMMENT_FILE_INVALID: A file could not be attached: upload it yourself first and do not repeat it.

impersonation.idle: It ends by itself after {{minutes}} minutes without activity.

adminMode.used: This code was already used. Wait for the next code in your app and enter it.
adminMode.locked: Too many wrong attempts. Try again in a few minutes.
adminMode.expired: Platform admin mode stopped because of inactivity. Turn it on again when you need it.
